h: Two of Tinubu's ministerial nominees were reportedly turned down by a group close to Buhari
p: A report says two people President Tinubu once considered for ministerial posts were rejected by a circle linked to former President Buhari. The claim has not been confirmed by the Presidency. A former presidential aide has separately offered his explanation for why Fasola is not in the cabinet.
more: The report was circulating widely on political blogs on Sunday.
The Presidency has not publicly responded to the claim.
